knowledge.name: Synthetic case snapshot
knowledge.detail: Fictional inquiries, customer context, priorities, sentiment, open issues, and interaction history support safe demonstrations.

knowledge.name: Approved knowledge guidance
knowledge.detail: Packaged articles, policies, playbooks, workarounds, and resolution steps provide source-backed support evidence.

knowledge.name: Routing and quality rules
knowledge.detail: Synthetic queue, SLA, CSAT, NPS, and survey evidence supports routing and service-quality review.

intelligence_processing.name: Inquiry triage brief
intelligence_processing.detail: Joins case, knowledge, routing, and SLA context into a concise brief for an authorized back-office reviewer.

intelligence_processing.name: Knowledge evidence matching
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks approved articles and resolution steps against the inquiry without inventing policy or live-system facts.

intelligence_processing.name: Escalation recommendation
intelligence_processing.detail: Recommends the applicable team and response target but never executes a route or changes a customer record.

intelligence_processing.name: Service quality signal review
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes fictional satisfaction metrics and recurring themes for human investigation without protected-trait inference.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Natural-language support experience for back-office agents, escalation managers, and quality analysts.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot access
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides a governed conversational entry point when approved organizational connections are configured.

clients_user_interface.name: Draft preview validation
clients_user_interface.detail: Locked persona cases let reviewers verify evidence and safety boundaries before any publication decision.

management_reporting.name: Satisfaction snapshot
management_reporting.detail: Presents fictional CSAT, NPS, response-time, resolution, distribution, and survey-comment evidence.

management_reporting.name: Escalation review evidence
management_reporting.detail: Shows recommended queue, SLA, rule trigger, and source labels while retaining human approval authority.

management_reporting.name: Acceptance audit trail
management_reporting.detail: Records locked-case results, package integrity, Draft status, and unpublished state for reviewer assurance.

tools.name: Customer Escalations Agent
tools.detail: Runs four read-only operations for inquiry, knowledge, routing, and satisfaction decision support.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the conversational agent in Draft and requires explicit authorized approval before publication.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
tools.detail: Potential governed source of CRM context after connection review; the package performs no customer-record mutation.

tools.name: SharePoint knowledge
tools.detail: Potential approved source for articles, policies, case studies, and playbooks under least-privilege access.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams and Outlook
tools.detail: Potential reviewer collaboration surfaces; the agent does not send messages, contact people, or create follow-ups.

supporting_features.name: Authorized human review gate
supporting_features.detail: Every response, route, escalation, and external action remains a recommendation for an authorized service reviewer.

supporting_features.name: No customer-record mutation
supporting_features.detail: The agent never updates a case, changes priority, assigns a queue, issues a refund, or alters customer data.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic data isolation
supporting_features.detail: Demonstrations use fixed fictional records and do not claim access to live customer or service systems.

supporting_features.name: Least-privilege connections
supporting_features.detail: Production sources may be bound only after security, privacy, and business-owner approval.

supporting_features.name: Draft publication control
supporting_features.detail: The validated package stays unpublished until locked cases and guardrails pass explicit reviewer approval.

supporting_features.name: Evidence-backed validation
supporting_features.detail: Four persona-language cases verify source anchors, operation behavior, review gates, and non-execution wording.
